properties.name: vacuum-frameware-version

properties.name: status
properties.label: Status
properties.note: Main state machine; also pushed as event. Official EN labels by list position: 1 Standby, 2 Charging, 3 Recharging to resume, 4 Working, 5 Pausing, 6 Returning, 7 Cleaning the mop, 8 Remote controlling, 9 Fully charged, 10 Mapping, 11 Updating, 12 Station working (cleaning), 13 Switching tasks, 14 Station working (charging), 15 Error, 16 Sweeping and Mopping, 17 Mopping, 18 Pausing map creation, 19 Returning midway, 20 Wash break (resume after wash), 21 Returning after mapping, 24 Returning (assisting cleaning), 25 Self-checking, 26 Summoning, 27 Cleaning summoned area. Live: 9 (Fully charged) on dock. Note 16/17 exist in list but live sweep reports 4 on sibling models (Aohzan) - verify while cleaning. [Aohzan API doc, live R3]

properties.name: fault
properties.label: Device Fault
properties.note: Last fault code (uint32 up to 420000). Aohzan notes it LATCHES the last code and does not reset on X20 Max; pv21cn reports task-event codes here (100051 start, 100008 return). Use 2.66 fault-ids for the live list. No code->text table anywhere; localized text comes from cloud message feed /v2/message/v2/list type 6 (params.body.event "2.3"). Known: 1000xx = robot/station hardware checks, 21xxxx = navigation failures (210009 cannot return to dock, 210005 could not reach target), 100027 sewage tank full/not installed.

properties.name: sweep-mop-type
properties.label: Mode
properties.note: Cleaning mode: 1 Vacuuming, 3 Vacuuming & Mopping, 4 Vacuuming before mopping (value 2 pure mop deliberately absent: roller mop cannot mop-only, FAQ Q39). Writable, applies to next task.

properties.name: sweep-type
properties.label: type
properties.note: Sweep type of the CURRENT task (1 Global,2 Zone,3 Area/room,4 Edge,5 Custom,6 Point,7 Custom Area,8 Appointment,9 Linkage,10 Fast,11 AI Hosting). Read-mostly; after a zone clean it reads 2. Use it (or current-cleaning-config) to confirm a zone/room command was really accepted, because code:0 is returned for garbage. [roquerodrigo#119]
properties.danger: A write is accepted and ignored: the value is set only by the start actions.

properties.name: cleaning-area
properties.label: Cleaning Area
properties.note: Cleaning area of current/last task. Live 2022 with 2103 s: unit probably 0.01 m2 (Gladys: hundredths of m2) -> 20.22 m2; unit unconfirmed by spec (no unit declared). [live, Gladys PR#10]

properties.name: cleaning-time
properties.label: Cleaning Time
properties.note: Cleaning time seconds (spec unit s). Live 2103 = 35 min.

properties.name: clean-times
properties.label: Times
properties.note: Repeat count 1..3 for the next task (FAQ: once or twice in app). For zone cleaning the repeat count is set here BEFORE start-zone-sweep. [roquerodrigo#119]

properties.name: mode
properties.label: Suction
properties.note: Suction level; official labels Silent(1) Standard(2) Strong(3) Turbo(4) (spec names Basic/Full Speed). Max 35 kPa at Turbo. Noise <=63/66/70/74 dB(A).

properties.name: mop-water-output-level
properties.label: Water output for mopping
properties.note: Roller water level 0 Off,1,2,3 (labels Level 1..3). 0 = dry (vacuum only).
properties.danger: Writing 0 (Off) is accepted and ignored while the cleaning mode includes mopping.

properties.name: mop-status
properties.label: Mop Status
properties.note: Mop module attached (roller mop installed). Live true.

properties.name: zone-ids
properties.label: Zone IDs
properties.note: Input property of start-zone-sweep (2.37) and set-zone (2.12): bare string JSON array of zone objects [{"blocks_region":[x1,y2,x1,y1,x2,y1,x2,y2],"blocks_attr":0}] in map millimetres (UL, LL, LR, UR). Max 3 zones per task (10 for saved presets). Not writable via set_properties, empty when read. [roquerodrigo#119, hass-xiaomi-miot#2867: original plugin com.xiaomi.robovac v57 source]

properties.name: restricted-sweep-areas
properties.label: Restricted Sweep Areas

Payload entries use fb_point (8 numbers, 4 corners mm) and fb_attr (0 no-go all, 1 no-mop) in the cloud map; the property carries the same structure (hypothesis, verify live on a copy of the empty state).
properties.danger: A write replaces the whole set of restricted areas.

properties.name: restricted-walls

properties.name: vacuum-room-ids

actions.name: start-vacuum-room-sweep
actions.label: Start Vacuum Room Sweep
actions.note: Start room cleaning. In piid 15 is the room ids as TEXT: "3" or "3,4" or "[3,4]" (JSON array text); the order in the list is the order of cleaning (inferred). Run settings (mode, suction, water, repeat) are taken from the global properties unless set-room-clean-configs was used. Room ids are the grid ids of the map (3, 4, 5, 6, 8 on this home).
actions.danger: Only the piid-tagged form in:[{"piid":15,"value":"3,4"}] starts the clean. A plain value in:["3,4"] is answered with code 0 and does nothing. A JSON array as the value (not text) answers -9999 user ack timeout and restarts the robot application, which resets the station settings, so piid 15 must always be sent as a string. Verify with status and sweep-type 3.

live.effect: piid-tagged text values start the room clean (sweep-type 2.5 becomes 3, current-cleaning-config 2.40 rooms equal the ids, status 4); plain values do nothing; a real JSON array value gave -9999 and restarted the robot application

actions.name: start-zone-sweep
actions.label: Start Zone Sweep
actions.note: Start zone cleaning. In piid 12 is a JSON array as TEXT: [{"blocks_region":[x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4],"blocks_attr":0}] in map millimetres, a rectangle as four corners (the app allows up to 3 zones in custom clean and 5 on the home page). Verify via sweep-type 2.5 = 2 and current-cleaning-config 2.40 zones.
actions.danger: Only the piid-tagged form in:[{"piid":12,"value":"[{\"blocks_region\":[...],\"blocks_attr\":0}]"}] was proven; a plain value is answered with code 0 and does nothing, and a malformed zone payload is answered with code 0 and then reports fault 210005. A zone start with a dirty mop first washes the mop at the dock (about 3 minutes). Set clean-times 2.8 first and verify sweep-type 2.

live.effect: piid-tagged zone starts the zone clean (sweep-type 2.5 becomes 2, current-cleaning-config 2.40 zones equal the region); the run finished, the cleaned area was pushed and the station mop wash followed
